## 🎯 Skill Identifier & Name
- **Skill ID**: `e.g. quantum-security-architect`
- **Skill Name**: `Quantum Security Architect`
- **Cluster**: `07_security_architecture` (or new cluster)

## 📌 ISO 42010 Architectural Specification
- **ISO Aspect**: `e.g. Post-Quantum Cryptography & Identity`
- **Concerns**: `PQC migration, lattice-based cryptography, key exchange`
- **Viewpoints**: `Cryptographic Inventory Viewpoint, Key Management Viewpoint`

## 📥 Required Inputs & Expected Deliverables
- **Required Inputs**: `System cryptographic inventory, algorithm baseline`
- **Expected Deliverables**: `PQC Migration Roadmap, Cryptographic Spec`

## 🔗 Compatible Task Families
List compatible task family IDs (e.g., `01_discovery`, `10_security_design`).
